translations.web: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
translations.bsb: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
translations.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
translations.asv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are illtreated, as being yourselves also in the body.
